ml_match.author: techhalla
ml_match.prompt_snippet:
You are a world-class motion designer doing a 20.00s kinetic identity bumper for TechHalla — an AI creator known for stealable workflows, not vibes. This piece must feel like the best designer in the room made a street-poster that moves. Showreel stakes: if this is weak, you don’t get hired.

DURATION: exactly 20.00 seconds. LOOPABLE: frame 0 == fr

scenes.voiceover: Hungry? Don't wait. Get your favorite meals delivered in minutes.
scenes.veo_prompt: Cinematic close-up of a diverse group of friends laughing and sharing a feast, vibrant food photography, high energy, modern aesthetic.

scenes.voiceover: Browse top-rated local restaurants and track your order in real-time.
scenes.veo_prompt: Clean modern smartphone screen showing the Zomato app interface scrolling through delicious food images, smooth UI animation.

scenes.voiceover: Our delivery network is optimized to get your food to you faster than ever.
scenes.veo_prompt: Split screen layout with a Zomato delivery partner riding through a sunny city street on one side and a steaming gourmet dish on the other.

scenes.voiceover: Download Zomato and get your next meal in minutes.
scenes.veo_prompt: Minimalist background with the Zomato logo centered, bold call to action buttons for App Store and Google Play.
